backup.title: Data Migration
backup.description: Back up sites, models, keys, and history for migration or recovery after reinstalling.
backup.passphraseDesc: This passphrase opens this backup file only. Store it separately.

validation.fileInvalid: Invalid file format. Select a .xlyra backup file

export.title: Export Data
export.dialogDescription: The backup includes recoverable data and some sensitive credentials. Choose a passphrase for this export.
export.noticeSensitive: Includes sites, models, credentials, OAuth accounts, downstream API keys, request logs, and usage records.
export.noticePassphrase: Keep the passphrase safe. You will need it again when importing.

import.passphraseDesc: Enter the passphrase set when this backup was exported.

import.noticeRestart: Health state, route cooldowns, and rate limit windows are not restored; the system will rebuild them.

jsPlugins.title: Plugins
jsPlugins.description: Sandboxed JavaScript hooks extend the gateway. Upload a .xlp package or install one from the plugin market, then enable a version here to join the runtime.
jsPlugins.emptyUploadedHint: Upload a .xlp plugin package, or install one from the plugin market.
jsPlugins.uploadedHint: Upload .xlp or install from the plugin market, enable one version for production, or uninstall inactive versions. Capabilities follow the package manifest (kind, apiVersion).
jsPlugins.uploadDropzone: Drop a .xlp file here or click to browse
jsPlugins.uploadFileHint: ZIP archive (.xlp) with manifest.json and plugin.js
jsPlugins.unavailable: Plugin storage is not available on this server.
jsPlugins.uninstallAllBody: This uninstalls all {{count}} versions of “{{name}}” and removes its bindings, queued events and action log. References to it in site settings are left alone; without the plugin a site goes back to its default behavior. This cannot be undone.
jsPlugins.uploadVersionConflict: This version already exists with different contents. Bump the version number and upload again.
jsPlugins.trustedKeyExists: This public key is already trusted.
jsPlugins.kindNotConnected: This plugin type is defined but not connected to xLyra yet, so it cannot be enabled.

errors.untrustedNotAllowed: This plugin type must be signed by a trusted key. Import the matching public key under Trusted keys first.
errors.siteTypeLocked: Sites are still using site type {{from}}. The new version cannot change it to {{to}} ({{count}} sites).
errors.inUse: {{count}} sites still use site type {{site_type}}. Delete those sites first.
errors.hostsRequired: Confirm the hosts this plugin may access before enabling it.

jsPlugins.deleteConfirmBody: Remove {{id}} version {{version}}. Disable the plugin first if this version is enabled.
jsPlugins.metricsHint: Each plugin code run (sign-in, refresh, quota fetch, model list, and similar) counts once. Only a plugin code error counts as a failure; it does not mean the account itself is unavailable. Counts reset when the service restarts.
jsPlugins.trustedKeysHint: Import ed25519 public keys from plugin developers. Signed packages from trusted keys can be enabled without an extra confirmation.
jsPlugins.trustedKeyDeleteBody: After removal, plugin packages signed by "{{name}}" will no longer be trusted directly and will require confirmation when enabled.
jsPlugins.unsignedBody: This version has no valid signature.json. Confirm before enabling.
jsPlugins.untrustedBody: This package is signed, but the signer is not in your trusted keys list. Import the public key above or confirm to enable anyway.
jsPlugins.enableConfirm: I understand the risk and want to enable this version
jsPlugins.hostsBody: This plugin will be allowed to access the following hosts. Please confirm.
jsPlugins.permissionsBody: This plugin acts automatically when certain events happen in xLyra. Enabling it grants the permissions listed below.
jsPlugins.permissionsScopeHint: A permission only decides what kind of action it may take. It can only act on the accounts and objects you bind under Automations afterwards.
jsPlugins.permissionsConfirm: I understand and grant these permissions

permission.apikeyResetUsage: Reset the usage (total, daily or weekly) of the API keys bound to it
permission.notify: Write notices to the plugin's action log
permission.httpRequest: Send HTTP requests to the addresses you enter in a binding (for example push notifications)

automation.title: Automations
automation.hint: Choose the OAuth account it watches and the API keys it may act on. When that account has an event the plugin subscribes to, the plugin decides what to do and xLyra carries it out.
automation.schedule: It also runs on its own every {{minutes}} minutes, whether or not anything changed.
automation.empty: No automations yet. The plugin handles no events until you add one.

reason.provider_not_supported: This account type is not supported

jsPlugins.bindProtocolHint: After enable, routes POST /v1/plugins/<slug>. Must match manifest downstreamPath.
jsPlugins.pricingReviewConfirm: I have reviewed the result and allow this plugin to provide prices for this site.

bindSiteHint.model_list: When this site syncs models, this plugin fetches the model list.
bindSiteHint.credential_check: This plugin validates keys and runs health checks for this site.
bindSiteHint.error_classifier: Upstream errors of this site are classified by this plugin (it only picks a class and cannot change cooldown length).
bindSiteHint.pricing_parse: When this site refreshes its models, this plugin reads and saves the prices. It changes the prices shown for the site, so preview and review them first.

globalKindHint.site_detect: Once enabled, this plugin also runs when xLyra detects a site type; it can only point to site types xLyra already supports.
globalKindHint.model_metadata: Once enabled, it applies to every site. It only fills in missing model names and capabilities and never overrides existing values.

siteBinding.optional: Binding is optional: without it the plugin is loaded but not used on any site.

jsPlugins.bindQuotaHint: Sets the site internal quota_probe to plugin:<id> (not shown on the site form).

xlyraCloud.description: Connect this instance to your xLyra Cloud account to use official services such as developer plugins

unbound.title: Not connected
unbound.description: After connecting, you can view and manage this instance in the xLyra Cloud console.
unbound.privacy: After connecting, this instance periodically reports the xLyra version, installed plugin status, and the name, platform, last active time, and notification status of paired phones to xLyra Cloud. Site addresses, secrets, and configuration are not included.

pairing.title: Waiting to connect
pairing.heading: Pairing
pairing.instruction: In the signed-in xLyra Cloud console, choose Connect instance and enter this pairing code.
pairing.stepCopyOrScan: Choose “Copy and open Cloud” or scan the code
pairing.stepApprove: After signing in to Cloud, check that the pairing code matches the one above, then choose Approve
pairing.stepReturn: Come back here. Connected appears within a few seconds
pairing.scanHint: Scan with your phone, sign in to xLyra Cloud, then check the pairing code and approve
pairing.dismissHint: Closing this window does not cancel pairing. Approving in Cloud still connects automatically. To give up, choose “Cancel pairing.”
pairing.expired: Pairing code expired. Generate a new pairing code.
pairing.codeMissing: The pairing code is no longer available. Generate a new one.

bound.title: xLyra Cloud
bound.syncErrorHint: This does not affect xLyra. Sync will retry automatically.

revoked.title: Connection removed
revoked.description: This instance was disconnected on the account side.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.disconnectDescription: After disconnecting, this instance will no longer sync to xLyra Cloud. Connecting again requires a new pairing code. xLyra itself keeps running.

developer.title: Developer
developer.none: This account is not a developer yet. Apply on the xLyra Cloud developer page, then refresh here.
developer.unavailable: Developer identity cannot be read right now
developer.pending: The application is waiting for approval. You can register keys and submit plugins after it is approved.
developer.rejected: The application was rejected. You can apply again on xLyra Cloud.
developer.suspended: The developer identity is suspended. Published plugins stay available. Submitting resumes after it is restored.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Manage devices paired with the xLyra App.

pairing.title: Add Device
pairing.hint: Scan the QR code with the xLyra App, or enter the instance address and pairing code in the App. The code is valid for 5 minutes and can only be used once.
pairing.createFailed: Failed to create the pairing code
pairing.confirmDescription: Your phone will connect to xLyra using the address below. Make sure your phone can reach it. To use a different address, close this window and reopen xLyra from an address your phone can access.
pairing.scanHint: Scan the QR code with the xLyra App, or enter the server address and pairing code in the App manually.

list.title: Connected Devices
list.emptyDescription: Generate a pairing code and scan it with the xLyra App to add a device.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke Device
revokeDialog.description: The device will lose access and must be paired again.

revokeAllDialog.title: Revoke All Devices
revokeAllDialog.description: All paired devices will be revoked and lose access.

push.unregisteredHint: Turn on notifications in the xLyra App on your phone, and the push status will show up here.
push.invalidHint: Open the xLyra App on your phone again to register notifications.
push.cloudRequired: Push requires this instance to be bound to xLyra Cloud
